content_json.retry_policy: Do not retry unchanged input for 409 email_taken or 422 validation_failed; a validation retry must be treated as a new logical operation with a fresh Idempotency-Key. For 401 token_expired, refresh the access token once and retry the request once. POST /users supports an optional Idempotency-Key for safe retries of the same semantically identical request; without a key, do not auto-retry after an ambiguous outcome, and reusing a key with different content yields 409 idempotency_conflict.

content_json.retry_policy: Without an Idempotency-Key, POST /users is not idempotent and must not be retried automatically after an ambiguous outcome. With an Idempotency-Key, it is safe to retry the semantically identical request. For token_expired (401), refresh the token once and retry once. For validation_failed (422) and email_taken (409), do not retry unchanged input.
